_doc: Live get_valuation metric catalogue, harvested from the tool's OWN validation error (send any invalid metric name and it lists every valid one). Cached so the flash costs no extra MCP call. Refresh when older than ~7 days, or the day InSync ships a new metric: run get_valuation(ticker_id=<any>, mode='NTM', metrics='__CATALOGUE_PROBE__', limit=1), paste the error text, and re-run references/valuation_catalogue.py. The sector chains in run_math.py carry the IDEAL primary at the top and are filtered against this list at request time, so a metric that does not exist yet is skipped silently today and leads the anchor automatically the day it appears.
